trials.claim: Purchase provides lifetime access to features and limits in selected tier
trials.claimQuote: Your purchase provides lifetime access to the StoryChief features and limits included in your selected tier, subject to the deal terms.
trials.reasoning: The binding terms let StoryChief change its services and features at any time and terminate an account for any reason on one month's notice, which materially limits any lifetime-access promise despite positive reviews.

exhibits.quote: STORY CHIEF has the right to change the offer and the composition of its Services (as well as its modules and/or features) whenever it decides to do so.
exhibits.argument: Vendor can change features at any time, so lifetime access to a fixed feature set is not guaranteed.

exhibits.quote: STORY CHIEF may terminate the Agreement and deactivate the user account of the Customer at any time and for any reason by giving 1 (one) month's notice to the Customer.
exhibits.argument: Vendor can terminate access on one month notice, which voids any lifetime access promise.

exhibits.quote: They kept improving the tool for many years while honoring their commitments and licenses to Sumolings for all these years.
exhibits.argument: Reviewer confirms vendor honored lifetime commitments to early buyers over many years.

exhibits.quote: they have been very fair with early adopters and continued to give us value as they grew.
exhibits.argument: Reviewer confirms early adopters kept receiving value as the product grew.

trials.claim: Social post creation is unlimited subject to channel limits
trials.claimQuote: Social post creation is unlimited, subject to your plan's connected-channel limits and applicable platform restrictions.
trials.reasoning: The pricing table shows unlimited scheduling and unlimited social posts included, while also showing per-plan social-channel allowances, matching the claim that creation is unlimited subject to channel limits; the 10-channel report is consistent with that stated limit.

exhibits.argument: Buyer reports hitting a 10-channel cap despite needing 13 networks, undermining unlimited creation.
